title: Title-screening pre-fill — per-record output (v1, 2026-10-08, PRE-008 choice 8)
description: One record's pre-fill of your_disposition / your_code / your_comment for ti_review_B.xlsx / ti_review_C.xlsx (pilot_100_blind, sample_verify sheets). Validated by scripts/triage_run.py / triage_run_concurrent.py against this schema.

record_id.description: Echo of the input record_id exactly as supplied (e.g. FS-000123).

code.description: Required non-empty (one of TI01-TI05) if and only if disposition is EXCLUDE_TITLE; otherwise must be the empty string.

comment.description: <=15 words. May be empty string when disposition is ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT.
